paper_title: Constraining Fundamental Constant Variations from Ultralight Dark Matter with Pulsar Timing Arrays
notes: Paper derives 95% C.L. constraints on scalar ULDM couplings (d_mhat, d_e(electron), d_mu, d_gamma, d_g) from PTA pulsar-spin-fluctuation and reference-clock-shift signals, but all results (Fig. 1) are obtained from MOCK data mimicking the IPTA DR2 dataset plus a hypothetical future PTA (Table II). The authors state application to real NANOGrav/IPTA data is planned future work. Hence this is a sensitivity projection, not a measured limit; no data points reported. Note the paper's 'd_gamma' corresponds to the canonical Damour-Donoghue dilatonic photon coupling d_e.
